title: A Great Monday
prompt: A ~60s INSAIT institutional brand film: a wonderfully ordinary day of Martin, the institute's Scientific Director — light-humored, day-in-the-life. Follows his Monday-morning path: he walks into our Synergy Tower, takes the elevator to the 13th floor, and runs the Monday stand-up — where he announces “our B200 GPUs have arrived. We now have B200s!”, cut to colleagues applauding. After the meeting he strolls into an office, calls out “Hi, Zhendong Li!” — no one there — “Where is Zhendong Li?”, spots only Jina, points at the packet of Jiali shaobing on her desk asking “What's this?”, and without waiting for her answer opens it, grabs one and strolls out with a “Great.”, then back in his own office he leans back in his chair, hands behind his head, starting a great day. Supplied references: photos of Martin and Jina, Synergy Tower exterior + aerial, lobby, the 13th-floor meeting room (INSAIT logo wall), a colleague's office, the shaobing packaging, the INSAIT logo — people, buildings, rooms, packaging and logo must stay consistent with the supplied images. The applauding colleagues are generic figures; the real people in the office photo are not drawn; no one but Martin and Jina depicts a real person; Zhendong (only called by name) never appears on screen. Style: the trendy AI colored-pencil illustration look (photo-to-hand-drawn: soft pencil strokes, fresh light watercolor, gentle natural light, faint paper grain; faces drawn at realistic proportions, features faithful to the photos), bright, credible, warm and approachable institutional tone. English dialogue with English subtitles, no voice-over, keep on-scene ambient sound. End on the INSAIT logo with the full institution name.
